# SingAway Career

> Licensed Singapore career consultancy for Indians and international candidates. Work permit, S Pass, Employment Pass, study visa, job placement and overseas recruitment — free consultation, 98%+ success rate.

SingAway Career (Singaway) helps candidates secure Singapore jobs, work permits (WP), S Pass, Employment Pass (EP), and student visas with transparent, end-to-end support from Zirakpur, India.

## Canonical URL
https://www.singawaycareer.com

## Services
- **Singapore Work Permit**: End-to-end work permit processing, employer matching and documentation.
- **S Pass Assistance**: Eligibility review, document preparation and MOM submission support.
- **Employment Pass**: Strategic guidance for skilled professionals applying for Singapore EP.
- **Study Visa Guidance**: University shortlisting, admission support, student visa documentation.
- **Career Consultation & Job Placement**: Free consultation and placement across hospitality, logistics, industrial, retail and airport roles.
